scenes.display_title: A small kitchen project and a larger comparison
scenes.spoken_text: Build a small-kitchen package and compare medium/large cases, identifying reusable details and changes that require renewed review.
scenes.caption: Build a small-kitchen package and compare medium/large cases, identifying reusable details and changes that require renewed review.

scenes.spoken_text: Combine user brief, site survey, layout, elevations, sections, devices, services and hardware. Test openings and reconcile cut lists to drawing revisions. List open issues before release; limited area does not remove access or service needs.
scenes.caption: A small project still needs every coordination interface.

scenes.spoken_text: Larger cases may introduce zones, users, appliances or an island. For each difference record its cause, affected elements, drawings/services and owner. Reuse a detail only if its conditions remain valid; floor-area growth does not scale drawer dimensions or fixing capacity.
scenes.caption: Compare changed use, not just floor-area ratios.

scenes.spoken_text: Quantity exercise: 4 base and 3 wall units total 7. The larger case has 6 + 4 + 1 = 11 base/wall/tall units, 4 more cabinets. This does not state panel count or cost difference. Each case needs its own part, service and inspection records.
scenes.caption: 7 and 11 count cabinets, not panels or prices.

scenes.spoken_text: The larger option adds an island. Updating cabinet counts alone misses changed movement, services and support. Create a difference card instead of copying the small-project approval. Decision: review changed execution conditions before reusing the package.
scenes.caption: Decision: review changed execution conditions before reusing the package.
